units.source_text: 此种破晓偷归的行径，夕雾向不习惯，觉得颇有趣味，但又很辛劳。

en.t: This kind of sneaking back at daybreak was something Yugiri was not used to; he found it rather interesting, but also quite exhausting.

units.source_text: 倘回三条院本邸，云居雁看见他浑身露湿，定将惊诧谴责。

en.t: If he went back to his main residence at Sanjo-in, Kumoi no Kari would see him drenched with dew from head to toe and would surely be shocked and reproach him.

units.source_text: 于是回到了六条院东殿花散里夫人处。

en.t: So he returned to Lady Hanachirusato's quarters in the eastern wing of Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 此时朝雾尚未散却，回想山中别墅，不知气象如何。

en.t: The morning mist had not yet lifted, and as he thought back to the villa in the mountains, he wondered what the weather there was like.

units.source_text: 众侍女看见了，悄悄地说道：“真奇怪，大将从来不曾破晓偷归呢！”

en.t: When the waiting women saw him, they whispered, "How strange. The General has never come home secretly at daybreak before!"

units.source_text: 夕雾暂时休息一下，就换衣服。

en.t: Yugiri rested for a short while, then changed his clothes.

units.source_text: 花散里夫人替他准备着冬夏种种崭新的衣服，立刻从熏香的中国式衣柜中取出来换上了。

en.t: Lady Hanachirusato had prepared all sorts of new clothes for him, for both winter and summer, and at once took them from a Chinese-style wardrobe scented with incense so that he could change into them.

units.source_text: 吃过早粥之后，他就去参见父亲。

en.t: After eating his morning rice porridge, he went to pay his respects to his father.
